:::{#exm-gamma}
#### Gamma density with shape 2

If $T \sim \dGamf{2, \rate}$,
then $\gammafn(2) = 1$,
so the [density](#def-gamma) is:

$$
f(t) = \rate^2 \, t \, \ef{-\rate t}, \quad t > 0
$$

The density is $0$ at $t = 0$, rises to a peak at $t = 1/\rate$, and then decays (@fig-gamma-density).

```{r}
#| label: fig-gamma-density
#| fig-cap: "Gamma densities with shape 2, by rate $\\rate$"
#| fig-alt: "Gamma densities with shape 2 rise from zero, peak, then decay."
#| code-fold: true

gamma_densities <-
  dplyr::tibble(rate = c(0.5, 1, 2)) |>
  dplyr::reframe(.by = rate, t = seq(0, 8, length.out = 400)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    density = dgamma(t, shape = 2, rate = rate),
    rate = factor(rate)
  )

gamma_plot <-
  gamma_densities |>
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::aes(x = t, y = density, col = rate) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    col = latex2exp::TeX("$\\lambda$"),
    y = latex2exp::TeX("$f(t)$")
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "bottom")

print(gamma_plot)
```

:::
